resources.title: Karma and Rebirth: a lecture by Mark Dyczkowski (free audio)
resources.licence: free to listen on the official archive (link only)
resources.note: How karma and rebirth are causally linked in Kashmir Śaivism. Listen on the archive's page.

resources.title: Development of Tantras in the Context of Buddhism and Upanishads (CIIS, 15 June 2010; free audio)
resources.licence: free to listen on the official archive (link only)

resources.title: Locating Trika (free course, Mark Dyczkowski)
resources.licence: free to listen on the official archive (link only)

resources.licence: paid course on the official archive
